scale.note: Seconds and log-price per pixel on the macro frame used to place the circles: 1 Apr 2014 through the last daily bar, padded like the chart, on an 840 by 692 plot. The rings are circles in that fixed frame, so panning and switching 1D, 4H, and 1H do not move them off these prices.

circles.name: Purple rings
circles.why: Both handles sit on the purple rising support. The 0.618 ring is resistance at the 14 Jul 2025 and 14 Aug 2025 highs. The 0.5 ring is support at the 10 Oct 2025 low, then resistance at the 14 Jan 2026 high and the 6 May 2026 high. The 0.786 ring is the next one out.

circles.name: Blue rings
circles.why: Both handles sit on the blue ceiling. One 0.618 ring is resistance on 20 Jan 2025, 14 Aug 2025, and 14 Jan 2026, then support at the 6 Feb 2026 low. The 0.5 ring is resistance on 22 May 2025 and support on 3 Aug 2025. By October 2026 those inner rings no longer cross the current bar.

circles.name: Yellow rings
circles.why: A second construction, on the yellow cycle floor, sized for the current path. The 0.236 ring is support at the 20 Aug reclaim and the 2 Sep low. The 0.618 ring is the ceiling at the 21 Sep high and the 2 Oct high. The 0.786 ring is the next one above that.

circles.name: Channel grid circle
circles.why: Both handles are intersections on the yellow channel's green 0.5 line: the purple aqua 0.618 on 8 Jan 2023, and the purple 0.5 line on 17 Dec 2026. The 0.5 ring is the 8 Dec 2023 high and the 14 Jul 2025 high, then support at the 25 Sep and 4 Nov 2025 lows. By 6 Oct 2026 price has moved to the right of that 0.5 ring and still sits inside the 1.0 ring.

circles.name: Green circle, rising rail
circles.why: Both handles sit on the steeper rising rail. The first is where that green rail crosses the magenta flat base on 5 Jun 2024. The second is where it crosses the flat 0.618 on 14 Jun 2025. The 0.618 ring is support at the 20 Sep 2024 low. The 0.5 ring is resistance through the Dec 2024 highs.

circles.name: Yellow circle, same rail
circles.why: The next pair of intersections on that same green rail, not a jump to another line. Handles are 14 Jun 2025 and 31 Jan 2026, where the rail crosses the flat 0.618 and the flat far rail. The 0.618 ring is resistance at the 27 Jul 2025 high.

circles.name: Cyan circle, rising 0.618
circles.why: Both handles sit on the steeper cyan 0.618. The first is the cross with the magenta flat base on 16 Jun 2025. The second is the cross with the flat 0.618 on 25 Jun 2026. The 1.0 ring is resistance at the 14 Jul 2025 high. The 0.618 ring is support at the 23 Sep 2025 low.

circles.name: Magenta circle, flat base
circles.why: Both handles sit on the magenta flat base. The first is the cross with the rising cyan 0.618 on 16 Jun 2025. The second is the cross with the rising yellow base on 15 Feb 2027. The 1.0 ring is resistance at the 13 Aug 2025 high. The 6 Oct 2026 close is just outside this circle's 0.5 ring and inside its 0.618 ring.
